brand_identity.name: CraftBolt
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Reliable, efficient, professional, no-nonsense, high-quality, authoritative.
brand_identity.visual_mood: Brutalist yet polished. High contrast, sharp edges, structured grid (Swiss design), monochromatic with bursts of high-visibility Orange.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Color is for function and guidance only.
The primary color (Orange) should be used sparingly for primary CTAs, active states, and important highlights to create maximum contrast.
Use 'Tinted Grey' rule: Even the #09090B has a slight tint to feel grounded, not just pure #000000.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.

headings.rules: Never use Inter or generic sans. Use extreme weight contrast. H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with strict, structured Swiss grids.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-none font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-8 py-4 transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] dark:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(255,255,255,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-foreground text-foreground hover:bg-foreground hover:text-background rounded-none font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-8 py-4 transition-all

cards.style: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift and shadow-lg.

header.style: Solid Background or heavy Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80). Must have 1px bottom border. z-50 fixed.
header.elements: Logo, 3-5 navigation links visible on desktop, date/time/weather/nameday widget (compact), login/register CTA.

badges.style: bg-primary/10 text-primary border border-primary/20 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest

hero.layout: Split Layout (Left: 7 cols, Right: 5 cols). Left: Massive H1, minimal subtext, Primary CTA, Stats bar. Right: Photo slider of craftsmen.
hero.bottom: 8-category bento grid attaching directly below the hero content.

stats_bar.style: Technical Grid style. Border-collapse layout with 1px borders separating metrics (Customers, Suppliers, Online).

advantages.layout: Two distinct columns or sections. High contrast vs Low contrast to separate Customer (White/Light gray bg) vs Supplier (Dark gray/Black bg).
advantages.items: 5 items each. Use sharp iconography (Phosphor Icons - Duotone or Bold).

how_it_works.layout: 6-step hexagon SVG diagram. Interconnected lines. Clean, numbered steps with bold labels.

pricing.layout: 2-card focus. Customer (FREE): Minimal, subdued. Supplier (PAID): High emphasis, use 'Tracing Beam' or glowing border effect to draw attention.

promoted_suppliers.layout: 8 ad banner slots. Use bento-style structured grid so it feels like a native architectural component, not cheap ads. Include countdown timers using monospace font.

cta_banner.style: Full width, high contrast. If light mode, use dark background (#09090B) with Orange button. Massive typography.

motion.hover: Crisp, snappy transitions. transition-all duration-200 ease-out.
motion.scroll: Use Framer Motion for entrance animations (staggered lists, fade-up on scroll). Keep it subtle (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1).

hero_slider_1.description: Carpenter working with tools. Use in hero slider.

hero_slider_2.description: Plumber fixing water heater. Use in hero slider.

hero_slider_3.description: Electrician with helmet. Use in hero slider.

blueprint_background.description: Architectural blueprint background. Use for Advantages or CTA section with heavy opacity overlay (bg-black/80).

mobile_app_banner.description: Person holding smartphone. Use for the Mobile App Banner section.

icons.style: duotone or regular. Keep stroke width consistent.

attributes: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements. e.g., data-testid='hero-register-button', data-testid='category-card-plumber', data-testid='supplier-pricing-cta'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use generic Shadcn cards for the main layout grid. Use raw divs with grid layout to maintain the Brutalist/Swiss technical look.
The Hero section MUST NOT use a blanket overlay that kills the slider images. If text contrast is needed, use a tight gradient overlay only behind the text.

For the 6-step hexagon diagram, use SVG paths to draw the hexagons and dashed connector lines, or arrange divs dynamically with clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%).
The site must be fully responsive, scaling typography cleanly without exceeding text-6xl on desktop.
Implement the 'neo-brutalist' button style for primary CTAs: sharp corners, high-contrast solid background, and a sharp solid drop-shadow.
